rows.text: "Step right up! Feast your eyes on the finest relics, all excavated straight from the ruins of the Era Chrysea! If it's fake, I'll pay you back tenfold!" A masked merchant calls out, their voice cutting through the marketplace bustle.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You sift through the shelves and, sure enough, spot some real treasures. But after sneaking a glance at the prices, you instinctively tighten your grip on your wallet — looks like it's time for some haggling.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "By Zagreus above! I risked life and limb to recover... Oh, I mean, acquire these relics! You can't expect me to leave out the danger fee!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You hesitate, unsure of what to do.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
